sections.text:
-Target: all enemies. Ability Power 500. Success value 100. 5x physical damage (Water).
Ability Power boosted by 10 for each increase in Skill level.
-Target: all enemies. Removes buffs.
-Target: all allies. Removes debuffs and special debuffs.
-Target: all allies. Removes status ailments.
-Target: all allies. Recovers 100% of max HP.
-Target: yourself. Applies Armament for 120 seconds (When in effect, damage to HP and CP will not be taken; increases ATK and MATK by 100%; nullifies Cost reduction and Unison gauge reduction; permits piercing through damage reduction, damage reflection, and damage nullifying effects when attacking. Removed after receiving a set amount of damage (300% of max HP excluding buff and field effects)).
[Additional Unison Effect] Target: all allies. Applies the following effect for 120 seconds: Recovers 10 Cost when using an Ability.
[Additional Unison Effect] Target: all allies. Removes special status ailments.
[Additional Unison Effect] Target: all allies. Applies Miracle.
Increases stats selected in stat slot 1 and stat slot 2 by 40000
All Element Defense from Unison Damage +200
Only [Reunion] Filo can be used as Unlocking Potential material
